entries.1bc766a236e6b3e6: This is the group's core business, manufacturing and selling wellness care-related products (such as adult incontinence care products), feminine care-related products (sanitary products) and baby care-related products (disposable diapers for babies). Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥774,428 million (down 6.3% year on year). As of December 31, 2025, 45 companies were listed under this business segment, with the main companies including the company itself, Unicharm Products Co., Ltd., Unicharm Kokko Nonwoven Co., Ltd., Cosmotec Co., Ltd., Jiaolian Co., Ltd., Uni.Charm (Thailand) Co., Ltd. and PT UNI-CHARM INDONESIA Tbk. Management's analysis describes the background to the decline in overseas sales as follows: in China, sales temporarily fell due to reputational damage from media reports on the quality and waste management of sanitary products; in India, sales temporarily stagnated because distributors adjusted their inventories following a revision of the GST (Goods and Services Tax) system.
entries.271b18322be2b62c: A company that makes and sells hygiene products such as disposable diapers and feminine care products, and pet care products, in Japan and overseas.
entries.5bab8d9689c8d032: Sofy Be (menstrual and health management app)
entries.66b6b20652035dee: These are food and treats for dogs and cats. In Japan, it states that it met consumer needs with an extensive lineup responding to variety in texture and flavor and rising health consciousness. It launched new products under the Gin no Spoon cat treat brand and the Gran Deli wet dog food brand. No separate revenue is disclosed for this category; the figures readers can check on the page are limited to those of the reportable segment.
entries.726b7ca1ffe869c1: These are pet toilet products and absorbent wear. For cats, it launched new chips for the replacement litter of the Deo Toilet system toilet, Deo Toilet Deodorizing and Antibacterial Chips; for dogs, it launched Manner Wear, absorbent wear for medium-sized dogs, expanding its lineup. No separate revenue is disclosed for this category; the figures readers can check on the page are limited to those of the reportable segment.
entries.a96183371197acad: This business manufactures and sells pet food-related products and pet toiletry-related products, among others. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥156,084 million (up 5.0% year on year). As of December 31, 2025, 18 companies were listed under this business segment, with the main companies including the company itself, Unicharm Products Co., Ltd., Unicharm Kokko Nonwoven Co., Ltd., Cosmotec Co., Ltd., Peparetto Co., Ltd. and The Hartz Mountain Corporation. In North America, sales of wet-type cat side food incorporating Japanese technology performed well, achieving high revenue growth. In China, in November 2022 it entered into a capital and business alliance with Jiangsu Jijia Chongwu Yongpin Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate, and has begun manufacturing pet food.
entries.c1f8099a2644ce66: These are products such as adult incontinence care products and masks. Overseas, in Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam and other countries where demand for adult incontinence care products is rising, it is promoting the spread of the Japanese care model through a combination of pad-type products and paper pants. In Japan, it states that it launched new products such as pant-type products and pads for paper pants, and achieved high sales growth. It also launched a product that uses recycled pulp, made from used paper pants, as part of its raw materials. No separate revenue is disclosed for this category; the figures readers can check on the page are limited to those of the reportable segment.
entries.ce58175d84a21216: This is a reportable segment that manufactures and sells industrial materials-related products, among others, leveraging processing and molding technologies for nonwoven fabrics and absorbent materials. It mainly sells industrial materials in the commercial products field. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥14,755 million (up 3.9% year on year). As of December 31, 2025, seven companies were listed under this business segment, with the main companies including Unicharm Kokko Nonwoven Co., Ltd., Cosmotec Co., Ltd. and Unicharm Gulf Hygienic Industries Co. Ltd.
